data.title: The Barista's Dilemma
data.statement:
A coffee shop has [[M]] baristas. Each barista prepares one drink at a time.

[[N]] customers arrive throughout the day. Customer [[i]] arrives at minute [[A]] and orders a drink that takes [[T]] minutes to prepare.

A drink may start only when:
- the customer has already arrived, and
- the assigned barista is not busy.

When several customers are waiting, the serving order may be chosen freely. Drinks cannot be interrupted once preparation has started.

The wait time of customer [[i]] is defined as:

`wait_i = finish_i - A_i`

where finish_i is the minute at which the drink is ready.

Find the minimum possible value of:

`wait_1 + wait_2 + ... + wait_N`

All baristas are available at minute 0.

INPUT
n: the number of customers
m: the number of baristas
arrival: the arrival minute of each customer
prepTime: the preparation time of each drink

OUTPUT
answer: the minimum total combined wait time

STATEMENT
Schedule drink orders across baristas to minimize total customer wait time.
Each customer arrives at a given minute and orders a drink with a fixed preparation time.
A drink starts only after the customer has arrived and the assigned barista is free.
Wait time is the minute the drink is ready minus the arrival minute.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A coffee shop has M baristas. Each barista prepares one drink at a time.

N customers arrive throughout the day. Customer i arrives at minute A and orders a drink that takes T minutes to prepare.

A drink may start only when:
- the customer has already arrived, and
- the assigned barista is not busy.

When several customers are waiting, the serving order may be chosen freely. Drinks cannot be interrupted once preparation has started.

The wait time of customer i is defined as:

wait_i = finish_i - A_i


where finish_i is the minute at which the drink is ready.

Find the minimum possible value of:

wait_1 + wait_2 + ... + wait_N


All baristas are available at minute 0.
Input
Line 1: Two integers N and M.

Line 2: N space-separated integers, the arrival minute A of each customer.

Line 3: N space-separated integers, the preparation time T of each drink.
Output
Line 1: One integer, the minimum total combined wait time of all customers.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000
1 ≤ M ≤ 10
0 ≤ Ai ≤ 10⁶
1 ≤ Ti ≤ 100
Example
Input
3 1
0 0 0
5 2 3
Output
17
